afterConceptual.title: Nice — you've got the idea.
dialogue: Alright, you've got the _shape_ of your Lab. That's the fun part.
Next we'll lock in logistics: date, presenters, slides, promotion, day-of details.
This part might take a couple weeks in real life — totally fine. You can come back anytime and everything will still be here.

afterLogistics.title: Phew. Planning complete.
dialogue: But it was _way_ less chaotic than my last experiment, so we're good.
Next, we'll lay everything out in one clean planning doc you can download — and I'll give you a ChatGPT link so you can keep refining things with my buddy.

outro.title: You're done. Go host something awesome.
dialogue: That's it — you've got a planning doc, and you can ask ChatGPT for help anytime with your event.
Last thing: after you host, please fill out the form so the OpenAI team can credit you and share what you learned.
Alright. Go be the reason your campus has a smarter AI conversation.
